# Security Checklist: SPEC-009C4 - Owner Merge Gate and Done Reconciliation

**Purpose**: Validate requirement quality for fixture/live trust boundaries, exact PR identity, manual owner-controlled merge proof, fail-closed GitHub evidence handling, and redacted smoke evidence.
**Created**: 2026-05-19
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This checklist is generated by the `/speckit.checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.

## Requirement Completeness

- [ ] CHK001 Are trust-boundary requirements complete for separating fixture or mocked PR evidence from live GitHub evidence used for production completion and smoke proof? [Completeness, Spec FR-015, Spec Clarifications Session 2, Research Fixture PR Evidence Decision, Contract Test Fixture Boundary]
- [ ] CHK002 Are exact PR identity requirements complete enough to require matching workspace/project scope, `github_repo`, `github_issue_number`, and `github_pr_number` before `done` can be reached? [Completeness, Spec FR-004, Spec Clarifications Session 2, Data Model PR-Producing Pilot Task]
- [ ] CHK003 Are fail-closed requirements complete for unrelated merged PRs, wrong repos, wrong PR numbers, closed-only issue evidence, missing PR evidence, unmerged PR evidence, and failed GitHub sync? [Completeness, Spec FR-005, Spec FR-006, Spec FR-007, Spec FR-019, Contract Fail-Closed Rules]
- [ ] CHK004 Are manual merge-gate requirements complete enough to make `G_PILOT_MERGE` the only allowed human intervention and to exclude automated validator, poller, webhook, scheduler, or local-only completion authority? [Completeness, Spec FR-001, Spec FR-002, Spec FR-003, Spec FR-008, Spec FR-017]
- [ ] CHK005 Are smoke-checklist evidence requirements complete for recording fresh PR identity, operator action, sync result, final task state, cleanup state, and explicit non-use of SPEC-009C3 PR #49 without adding packet or UI surfaces? [Completeness, Spec FR-012, Spec FR-013, Spec FR-014, Spec Clarifications Session 1]
- [ ] CHK006 Are evidence redaction requirements complete enough to keep raw terminal scrollback, environment dumps, tokens, Authorization headers, API keys, credential values, and matched secret substrings out of PR and smoke-checklist notes? [Security, docs/qa Evidence Redaction, Spec FR-020, Quickstart Live UAT Evidence]

## Requirement Clarity

- [ ] CHK007 Is authoritative merge proof clearly defined as current merged PR truth for the exact linked PR rather than supporting-only issue closure, labels, `merged_at`, `merge_commit_sha`, or timeline metadata? [Clarity, Spec Clarifications Session 2, Research Exact Merged PR State Decision, Contract Completion Rule]
- [ ] CHK008 Is fixture evidence clearly limited to automated test injection through direct `pullFromGitHub` coverage, while production API, UI, and future poller callsites are forbidden from passing fixture payloads? [Clarity, Spec FR-015, Contract Preconditions, Contract Test Fixture Boundary]
- [ ] CHK009 Is the manual sync authority boundary clear about `POST /api/github/sync` with `{ "action": "trigger", "project_id": <id> }` and the equivalent GitHub Sync panel path, without adding a new sync API? [Clarity, Spec FR-003, Spec Clarifications Session 1, Contract Entrypoints]
- [ ] CHK010 Are insufficient-evidence reasons clear enough to distinguish missing, unmerged, mismatched, closed-only, fixture-only, supporting-only, local-only, and failed-sync outcomes? [Clarity, Spec FR-007, Spec FR-019, Contract Fail-Closed Rules]
- [ ] CHK011 Is the operator-controlled merge action clear enough to distinguish human `G_PILOT_MERGE` proof from code-checkable gates and automated SpecKit artifact validation? [Clarity, Spec FR-001, Spec Clarifications Session 1, Data Model Owner Merge Gate]
- [ ] CHK012 Are acceptable smoke evidence fields clear enough to allow IDs, timestamps, counts, hashes, and sanitized error classes while excluding raw secret-bearing command output or credential material? [Clarity, docs/qa Evidence Redaction, Spec FR-020, Quickstart Live UAT Evidence]
